description: This file defines the ImpactDataProject class, which manages impact data associated with projects, including database interactions, data retrieval, and validation within the Goteo project.

classes.name: ImpactDataProject
classes.description: A model class representing the relationship between impact data and projects, including methods for data retrieval, persistence, and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ImpactDataProject object, loading related ImpactData and Project if IDs are set.

methods.name: getByProjectAndImpactData
methods.description: Retrieves an ImpactDataProject by project and impact data.

methods.name: getListByProject
methods.description: Returns a list of ImpactDataProjects for a given project.

methods.name: getCalculatedListByProject
methods.description: Returns a list of ImpactDataProjects with calculated estimation amounts for a project.

methods.name: getListByProjectAndFootprint
methods.description: Returns ImpactDataProjects associated with a project and footprint.

methods.name: getCalculatedByProjectAndFootprint
methods.description: Returns impact data with calculated estimation amounts for a project and footprint.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if an ImpactDataImpactDataProject exists for a given impact data and project.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the ImpactDataProject to the database.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the ImpactDataProject data before saving.
